description: This file declares the 'equation_t' class, representing mathematical equations, with methods for arithmetic operations, determinant calculation, and printing. It serves as an interface for handling equations within a math utilities module.

classes.name: equation_t
classes.description: Represents a mathematical equation with operators for arithmetic, determinant calculation, and printing functionalities.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments involved in the equation.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Overloads the multiplication operator for equation objects.

methods.name: operator/
methods.description: Overloads the division operator for equation objects.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Overloads the addition operator for equation objects.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Overloads the subtraction operator for equation objects.

methods.name: determinant
methods.description: Calculates the determinant of a matrix.

methods.name: minor
methods.description: Calculates the minor of a matrix element specified by row and column.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the equation to standard output.

methods.name: print_matrix_s
methods.description: Prints a matrix of type matrix_s_t.

methods.name: equation_t (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes an equation with a string or vector.

methods.name: ~equation_t (destructor)
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by an equation object.
